note: Seed data compiled from papers/abstracts — verify against original papers before citing. Community corrections welcome.

benchmarks.name: GEO-Bench-2
benchmarks.measures: Classification, segmentation, regression, detection, instance seg — grouped into capability groups with a standardized adaptation protocol
benchmarks.finding: No single GeoFM dominates across tasks; EO-pretrained models beat natural-image models on multispectral tasks, but DINOv3-class baselines stay competitive on RGB.

benchmarks.name: PANGAEA
benchmarks.measures: Global multi-domain dense prediction under a frozen-encoder protocol
leaders: varies by domain; FLORO reports strong results with a small pretraining set
benchmarks.finding: Frozen-encoder rankings differ sharply from fine-tuned rankings — adaptation protocol changes who wins.

benchmarks.name: LHRS-Bench
benchmarks.measures: RS understanding & reasoning, 690 multiple-choice questions across capability levels
leaders: LHRS-Bot-Nova (among open RS models at release)
benchmarks.finding: Small (108 images) — treat as a probe, not a ranking; contamination with common RS training sets is a real risk.

benchmarks.name: EarthMind-Bench
benchmarks.measures: Multi-granular (image/region/pixel) + multi-sensor (optical+SAR) understanding, MC and open-ended
benchmarks.finding: SAR subsets crush RGB-trained models: e.g. reported grounding-style scores EarthMind 13.6 vs GeoChat 2.6 (SAR) — the sensor gap is bigger than the model gap.

benchmarks.name: RSMMVP
benchmarks.measures: Vision-centric probes (counting, relative position, small objects) built from CLIP-blind pairs
benchmarks.finding: RS MLLMs fail systematically on spatial/counting probes; the bottleneck is the CLIP-class encoder (Slot A), not the LLM.

benchmarks.name: VRSBench / GeoChat-Bench
benchmarks.measures: Captioning, VQA, visual grounding on RS imagery
benchmarks.finding: Grounding IoU and text metrics diverge — always report both; many instruction sets share source data with these benchmarks (contamination).

benchmarks.name: GEOBench-VLM
benchmarks.measures: 31 geospatial sub-tasks for VLMs — scene understanding, counting, detection, localization, segmentation, temporal analysis
leaders: not yet tracked here — see the leaderboard in the official repo
benchmarks.finding: Became the default OOD check for RS-VLMs in 2026 (e.g. MLRS reports first place on zero-shot detection). Generalist VLMs stay competitive, which is the key point.

benchmarks.name: XLRS-Bench
benchmarks.measures: Ultra-high-resolution RS imagery (thousands of px per side) — perception and reasoning sub-tasks
benchmarks.finding: Directly measures G13 (resolution vs context). Token-pruning, zoom-search and program-execution methods (LRS-VQA, ZoomSearch, GeoScope) all target this regime.

benchmarks.name: TerraScope-Bench
benchmarks.measures: Pixel-grounded geospatial reasoning: coverage %, absolute area, distance, comparative area ranking, boundary relations, building change (3,837 samples)
benchmarks.finding: Moves VLM eval from 'is the answer right' to quantities that have to come from masks. New, so it has a single-source result so far.

benchmarks.name: Earth-Bench / ThinkGeo
benchmarks.measures: Tool-augmented agent tasks: multi-step EO workflows over RGB, spectral and product data (Earth-Bench: 248 tasks, 104 tools)
benchmarks.finding: Agent benchmarks score how tools are chosen and chained, not perception alone. Results depend heavily on the LLM backbone (GPT-5/Gemini vs open models).

benchmarks.name: GeoDisaster
benchmarks.measures: Operational disaster geo-intelligence: 2,921 verified instances, 43 question types, orchestrated agents
benchmarks.finding: Tests tool-grounded, evidence-backed decisions rather than captioning.

benchmarks.name: AESP (answer-grounding consistency)
benchmarks.measures: Whether a grounded-VQA model's localized evidence actually supports its textual answer
benchmarks.finding: Right answers with unsupported grounding are common. Pairs with FaithRS / GeoSolver on G14 faithfulness.

benchmarks.name: RRS-10K
benchmarks.measures: Rare-scene RS interpretation (10,738 military-related images), multitask
benchmarks.finding: Existing benchmarks are dominated by common urban/rural scenes, so long-tail performance goes unmeasured.

benchmarks.name: RSVideo
benchmarks.measures: VLM understanding of remote-sensing video: motion, actions, interactions, scene evolution
benchmarks.finding: Opens a video axis that single-image and sparse-temporal benchmarks miss.

benchmarks.name: VHR-Bench
benchmarks.measures: GeoFMs transferred to very-high-resolution EO imagery (individual buildings and roads)
benchmarks.finding: Most GeoFMs pretrain at ≥10 m GSD. This is a direct test of G4 (scale/GSD generalization).

benchmarks.name: FairRSFM
benchmarks.measures: Biome-aware group robustness (14 biomes → 6 macro-groups) under frozen-backbone eval on m-EuroSAT, m-BigEarthNet, m-SA-Crop-Type, MMEarth20K
benchmarks.finding: Aggregate scores hide biome gaps. Prithvi-EO 2.0 gets 90.98% macro-F1 on m-EuroSAT but 83.72% mean worst-group.
